description: Use this when DC Hub data looks wrong, missing, out of date or contradictory, a tool did not work as expected, or the user wants something DC Hub does not do yet. Files it for the DC Hub team, who review findings daily. Free; works with or without a key. Quote the exact values seen. Add contact_email only if the user asked for a reply. Not for data questions (execute_plan answers those).

args.description: The arguments you called the tool with

note.description: One or two sentences of context

quoted_fields.description: The exact fields/values you saw (object, list or string); hashed for dedupe

recurrence.description: How many times you have seen it (default 1)

region.description: The market, state, ISO or country it is about

tool.description: The DC Hub tool or endpoint it is about, e.g. analyze_site (optional for feature_request and coverage_gap)

name: report_finding
title: Report Finding
